entries.heading: INTEGRATED MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS
ancestors: TITLE VII—RESEARCH, EXTENSION, AND RELATED MATTERS
Subtitle B—Food, Agriculture, Conservation, and Trade Act of 1990
entries.text:
SEC. 7202. INTEGRATED MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS.

    Section 1627(d) of the Food, Agriculture, Conservation, and Trade 
Act of 1990 (7 U.S.C. 5821(d)) is amended by striking ``2018'' and 
inserting ``2023''.
